def.short: to copy a file, app, or song from the internet to your phone or computer
def.long: To copy a file, an app, a song, or a video from the internet to your own phone or computer. You usually press a button and wait for a bar to fill.

examples.en: I downloaded the app, but I can't log in.
You can download the ticket from your email.
It takes a long time to download big files on slow Wi-Fi.
examples.tr: Yavaş Wi-Fi'da büyük dosyaları indirmek uzun sürüyor.

tr.note: Türkçede 'yüklemek' hem upload hem install için kullanıldığından karışır. Download = indirmek: internetten kendi telefonuna veya bilgisayarına almak.

mistakes.wrong: I downloaded my photo to my profile page.
mistakes.right: I uploaded my photo to my profile page.
mistakes.why: Telefondan internete göndermek 'upload'dır (fotoğrafı profile yüklemek). Download ise internetten telefonuna almaktır (indirmek).

tr.mnemonic: Down = aşağı: dosya buluttan (internetten) telefonuna iner. Tersi 'upload': telefondan buluta çıkar.

quiz.cloze: I need to ______ this app before I can use it.

def.micro: send a file to the internet
def.short: to send a photo, video, or file from your phone to the internet
def.long: To send a photo, video, or file from your phone or computer to a website or an app. After that, other people can see it or get it.

examples.en: I uploaded the photos to the shared folder.
She uploads a new video every Friday.
examples.tr: Her cuma yeni bir video yüklüyor.

examples.en: Please upload your CV to our website.

tr.note: Türkçede 'yüklemek' hem 'upload' (internete göndermek) hem 'install' (programı kurmak) için kullanılır. 'Upload' her zaman senden internete doğrudur.

mistakes.wrong: I uploaded the app on my phone.
mistakes.right: I downloaded the app on my phone.
mistakes.why: Telefona uygulama almak 'download' (veya 'install') olur. 'Upload' dosyayı telefondan internete göndermektir.

tr.mnemonic: Up = yukarı: fotoğraf telefonundan buluta (internete) çıkar. Tersi 'download': buluttan telefona iner.

quiz.cloze: I took some photos and want to ______ them to my website.

def.short: a secret word or set of letters and numbers that lets you open an account
def.long: A secret word or set of letters, numbers, and signs that you type to open your phone, email, or an account. You should never share it with other people.

examples.en: I forgot my password again.
Your password must have at least eight letters and numbers.
examples.tr: Şifreniz en az sekiz harf ve rakamdan oluşmalı.

examples.en: Don't share your password with anyone.

tr.note: Günlük Türkçede 'şifre', yazılı ve resmî dilde 'parola' denir. 'Şifre' kelimesinin gizli yazı anlamı İngilizcede 'code' veya 'cipher'dır.

quiz.cloze: Enter your ______ to open your email account.

def.short: a device and cable that put power into a phone or laptop
def.long: A small device or cable that you plug in to put power into the battery of a phone, laptop, or other device. Many people carry one in their bag.

examples.en: Do you have a phone charger I can borrow?
examples.tr: Ödünç alabileceğim bir şarj aletin var mı?

examples.en: I left my charger at the office.
This charger is too slow; it needs three hours.
examples.tr: Bu şarj aleti çok yavaş; üç saat sürüyor.

tr.note: Türkçedeki 'şarj' de aynı kökten gelir (charge). 'Şarj aleti' = charger. 'Şarjım bitti' ise 'My battery is dead' olur.

mistakes.wrong: Do you have a charge for my phone?
mistakes.right: Do you have a charger for my phone?
mistakes.why: Şarj aleti 'charger'dır. 'Charge' fiil (şarj etmek) veya isim olarak ücret / elektrik yükü demektir, alet değil.

quiz.cloze: My phone is almost dead. Do you have a ______?

def.short: the part inside a phone, car, or toy that stores power
def.long: The part inside a phone, laptop, car, or toy that stores electricity so it can work without a plug. Small ones are used in remote controls and clocks.

examples.en: My phone battery is almost dead.
How long does the battery last?
The remote doesn't work. We need new batteries.

tr.note: Küçük pillere 'pil'; telefon ve laptop için hem 'pil' hem 'batarya' denir; arabada 'akü'dür. Telefonun 'şarjı' dediğimiz şey İngilizcede 'battery'dir: 'My battery is low.'

mistakes.why: Türkçede 'bitti' deriz, ama İngilizcede pil bitince 'dead' (veya 'ran out') denir; 'finished' kullanılmaz.

quiz.cloze: My phone turned off because the ______ was dead.

def.short: a photo of what you see on your phone or computer screen
def.long: A picture that your phone or computer takes of what is on its screen at that moment. People use it to save messages, tickets, or maps.

examples.en: Can you send me a screenshot of the message?
examples.tr: Mesajın ekran görüntüsünü bana gönderir misin?

examples.en: I took a screenshot of the ticket.
Send a screenshot of the error to the support team.
examples.tr: Hatanın ekran görüntüsünü destek ekibine gönderin.

tr.note: Gençler günlük dilde kısaca 'ss' der ('ss at'). İngilizcede 'screen grab' ve 'screencap' de denir ama en yaygını 'screenshot'tır.

mistakes.wrong: I took screenshot of the map.
mistakes.right: I took a screenshot of the map.
mistakes.why: Türkçede 'bir' çoğu zaman söylenmez. İngilizcede tekil sayılabilir isimden önce 'a' gerekir: a screenshot.

quiz.cloze: I took a ______ of the map, so I can use it without internet.

def.short: a new version of an app or phone system that fixes problems or adds things
def.long: A new version of an app, a phone, or a computer program that fixes problems or adds new things. Your phone often asks you to get one.

examples.en: There is a new update for this app.
examples.tr: Bu uygulama için yeni bir güncelleme var.

examples.en: My phone needs an update, but the storage is full.
examples.tr: Telefonumun güncellenmesi gerekiyor ama depolama alanı dolu.

examples.en: The update took twenty minutes to finish.

tr.note: Fiil olarak 'update' = güncellemek, isim olarak 'an update' = bir güncelleme. Haber dilinde 'son gelişme' anlamı da vardır.

quiz.cloze: My phone says there is a new software ______ to install.

def.short: to remove a file, photo, or message from a phone or computer
def.long: To remove a file, photo, message, or app from a phone or computer, so that it is no longer there. Be careful: some things cannot come back after this.

examples.en: I deleted all the old photos from my phone.
Please delete this message after you read it.
examples.tr: Lütfen bu mesajı okuduktan sonra sil.

examples.en: She deleted the app because it used too much battery.
examples.tr: Çok pil harcadığı için uygulamayı sildi.

etymology.text: From Latin 'delere', meaning 'to wipe out' or 'to destroy'.

tr.note: Dosya, fotoğraf ve mesaj silmek için 'delete' kullanılır; uygulama için 'delete' veya 'uninstall' denir. Kalıcı olarak silmek için 'permanently delete' denir.

quiz.cloze: I need more space, so I will ______ some old apps.

def.short: a word, picture, or address that you click to open another web page
def.long: A word, picture, or address on a screen that opens another page when you tap or click it. People often send one by message or email.

examples.en: Click the link to reset your password.
Can you send me the link to the video?
The link doesn't work. Can you send it again?

tr.note: Günlük dilde çoğu kişi 'link' der, yazılı dilde 'bağlantı' kullanılır. İngilizcede 'link' iki şey arasındaki bağ anlamına da gelir; bu kart tıkladığınız web bağlantısını anlatır.

quiz.cloze: I'll send you the ______ to the website in a message.

def.short: the options on a phone or app that you can change
def.long: The options on a phone, an app, or a device that you can change to make it work the way you like. You usually find them under a small gear icon.

examples.en: Open the settings and turn on dark mode.
I changed the privacy settings on my account.
Go to settings and check the Wi-Fi.

tr.note: Telefondaki 'Ayarlar' menüsü İngilizcede 'Settings'tir ve çoğul kullanılır. Tekil 'setting' ise tek bir ayar veya bir olayın geçtiği ortam demektir.

mistakes.wrong: Go to the setting and change the language.
mistakes.right: Go to settings and change the language.
mistakes.why: 'Ayarlar' çoğuldur: 'settings'. Menü adı olarak çoğu zaman 'the' bile gerekmez.

quiz.cloze: To make the text bigger, open your phone ______.
